attributes.name: repeated item container element
attributes.definition: Which HTML element wraps each repeated content item (news item, card, listing, FAQ block) on the page.

values.definition: Each repeated item is wrapped in a semantic article element.
Repeated items use generic div or list item wrappers.
Some other element or no repeated items.

attributes.name: date markup
attributes.definition: How dates or timestamps are marked up in the page's content items.

values.definition: Dates are wrapped in a semantic time element.
Dates appear as plain text or in generic spans.

attributes.name: repeated item heading level
attributes.definition: The heading level used for the titles of repeated content items or footer column headings.
